units.text: Both Benin and Guinea-Bissau debuted at the 2026 Winter Games; the United Arab Emirates was not a returning participant but made its first appearance.

citations.title: Olympic curiosities of 2026: Benin, Guinea-Bissau and the UAE set for historic debuts - Terrikon

judgement.reason: The passages explicitly state Benin and Guinea-Bissau are first-time Winter Olympic participants/debutants and that the United Arab Emirates will make its first Winter Olympics appearance, not a returning one.
